title: The Curse of Performance Instability in Analysis Datasets: Consequences, Source, and Suggestions

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance variance and inter-example prediction correlations across multiple training runs with different random seeds on NLI and RC analysis datasets (e.g., AdvSQuAD, SNLI-hard) designed to expose dataset artifacts and shortcuts.

Testing models on synthetic and rule-based datasets like HANS and NLI Stress Tests to measure their reliance on specific linguistic heuristics (e.g., lexical overlap, subsequence matching, negation, antonyms) and analyzing the resulting performance instability and inter-data covariance.
